description: Slot Zeist is the classicist palace finished in 1686. A seven-bay main block under a slate hipped roof is linked by one-storey flat-roofed wings to two-storey side houses around a forecourt. It is overcast, about 11.5°C, with wind near 6.1 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The interior is closed. The year on the door is not readable. The medieval castle is gone and is not rebuilt. The Broederplein houses are not this frame.
